openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Friday’s gate is a clearing sky — not the inbox. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Own the threshold from the first breath.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not open the board cold. Fierce calm is Friday composure under a clearing sky: charge first, body second, two clean must-dos, quiet admin only after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Friday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Sky clearing; tempo inside. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Clear sky is not the teaching
items.body: The operator who waits for perfect weather never crosses. Friday’s sun is a gift, not a credential. Cross with breath and body before you ask the day for a meeting.
Hermetic proportion: do not pour from an empty cup. Charge fills it. Admin waits. A thin line held is stronger than a transfer forced.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon’s wisdom was not speed for its own sake — it was right proportion. A king who rushes judgment breaks the vessel he meant to fill. Your morning is that vessel: breath sets the measure, body fills it, then the desks get a hearing. A day measured before it is opened holds shape; a day opened first spills.
grimoire.practice: After four rounds of box breathing, name one must-do out loud. Then start the 3-minute opener. Do not open mail until both are done.

lesson.oneLiner: Do not ask the model to ‘make a video.’ Ask it to build scenes in order.
beats: Concept — topic, audience, duration, style before any pixels.
Script + storyboard — hooks, on-screen text, timings.
Assets — SVG, icons, type. Then code: Remotion, GSAP, or plain HTML.
Render, then refine timing. Sequence beats a single prompt.
lesson.takeaway: Operator rule: sequence the work, then the model. @mmmik000 already ships that pattern on Vortex Breath.
